tools.name: list_flyway_projects
tools.description: List Flyway projects discovered under FLYWAY_ROOT with QA/Dev config availability.

tools.name: qa_flyway_migration
tools.description: QA Flyway Migration: run flyway repair and migrate for all configured projects against the QA environment. Use when the user says "QA Flyway Migration". Automatically fixes duplicate versions, checksum mismatches, Flyway placeholder errors in JS migrations, and missing-table failures where possible.

projects.description: Optional list of project folder names (e.g. my-service-db). Runs all discovered projects when omitted.

tools.name: dev_flyway_migration
tools.description: Dev Flyway Migration: run flyway repair and migrate for all configured projects against the Development environment. Use when the user says "Dev Flyway Migration". Automatically fixes duplicate versions, checksum mismatches, Flyway placeholder errors in JS migrations, and missing-table failures where possible.

projects.description: Optional list of project folder names (e.g. my-service-db). Runs all discovered projects when omitted.
